snippet.title: Is Air India’s Breakfast Actually Any Good? 🤔
snippet.description:
Flying from Delhi to Bengaluru with Air India, and naturally, I had to investigate the food! ✈️😂

The airport lounge was my first stop, where I went in for some “nutrition” and somehow ended up fighting for my life while peeling a boiled egg. I tried the chole, chicken sausages and a banana before making my way to the aircraft.

But breakfast wasn’t over yet! Once onboard, I had the classic bun and butter, sugar free chai, and an omelette so buttery that I genuinely wanted another one. I even turned it into an anda bread sandwich, and that bite was worth it. Between the lounge spread and the inflight meal, there was plenty to eat before landing in Bengaluru.

Now tell me, are you team airport lounge breakfast or team inflight meal? 👀

Episode Info 👇
Show Name - Bokul- বকুল
Full Episode Number - 177

About the Serial:-
--------------------------

    Odity is a young educated woman grown up in an orphanage. Parent-identity-less Odity, by staying in the orphanage and studying, has now become a well-known doctor of the city. For Odity, the orphanage itself is everything; all her salary, every bit of money, she spends in the orphanage. The caretaker of the orphanage house, Kabita Baideu, sometimes says – “Don’t spend all your salary money only in the name of the orphanage, keep something for yourself too.” But Odity does not listen to her words; according to Odity, the orphanage made her into a selfsufficient woman, gave her a new identity, therefore whatever she does now will only be for the orphanage’s development.
 
      There is a famous businessman of the city named Anabil chaliha. He has many businesses, but his main business is buying land at cheap rates and selling it later at higher prices. He has two sons. The elder son, Nibedan, once lost his eyes because of his father’s mistake. From that day, simple and sincere Nibedan was seen differently by his father, who thought him weak and incapable of handling hardship. On the other hand, the younger son, aditya, is completely opposite. A reckless young man. There is a lot’s of love and affection between the two brothers. Though Nibedan cannot see with his own eyes, he sees the world through the vision of his brother. aditya never lets Nibedan feel his blindness — he takes him everywhere, introduces him to every little things, every environment, so that Nibedan never feels different. 

    One day, Anabil Chilha’s eyes fell on the land of the orphanage house. He tried every way to acquire it, but failed again and again. aditya also visited the orphanage and makes unnecessary noise there, and that is how he met Odity. Slowly, conflict between the two escalated. One day, Aditya was injured in an accident and was admitted to the hospital where Odity worked. The responsibility of treatment fell on Odity. At first, she treated him only out of duty, but gradually some small incidents changed her thoughts about Aditya. Their bond moved from enmity towards love. And later she became the daughter in law of Anabil chaliha. 

    Kalyani was the elder daughter-in-law of Anabil chaliha. Born into a Poor family, being an educated girl, she had married Nivedan under certain circumstances. She found it difficult to accept a blind young man as her husband. Though she always kept a smile on her face, inside she was restless, and she wanted to make Anabil Chilha’s wealth her own together with her brother. After Odity entered the family as Aditya’s beloved, Kalyani realized her dream would not be fulfilled. She began to suffer mental anguish. And One day, after many conspiracies she was able to thrown Odity out of the house. This incident increased the conflict between the two brothers. 

   Odity is now unable to return to the orphanage house because Anabil Chaliha made the land his own at the same time. The people of the ashram now misunderstood Odity because Odity is now Anabil Chaliha's daughter-in-law.  

   After the incident, Odity and Aditya left the house, and their mother tried hard to bring them back because of her love for her youngest son but without success. Meanwhile, Anabil Chaliha became an enemy to Odity. One day, he conspired together with a doctor from the same hospital to defame her and able fired her from her job. The slander was serious enough for her to get a job in a private nursing home also. Aditya mother helped them from time to time, but that was not enough. They both began their struggling lives. Despite being a doctor and the son of a wealthy businessman in the city, they continued their struggling lives by opening a small food stall on the sidewalk.

   After a long legal battle, one day she got her job back. A few days later, Anabil Chaliha suffered from a serious illness and Odity healed him. The delicious taste of homemade paneer pizza, a traditional Indian village courtyard, and the beautiful joy of a family cooking together. 🍕🌿❤️

On a peaceful day in a traditional Indian village, a hardworking husband and wife come together to prepare a giant homemade paneer pizza for their family. The night before, the wife carefully prepares fresh homemade paneer from milk, strains it, and presses it overnight until it becomes soft and firm. By morning, the family is ready to begin a special cooking day.

One by one, fresh ingredients come together to create something delicious. Homemade pizza dough is kneaded and left to rise, fresh tomato sauce is prepared, paneer is cut into cubes, and mushrooms, capsicum, and onions are sliced. The wife prepares the giant pizza base while the husband builds and heats a traditional clay oven in the courtyard. Together, they spread the sauce, add generous layers of cheese and colorful toppings, and carefully bake their enormous homemade pizza. 🧀🍅🍕

As the giant pizza comes out of the clay oven with a golden crust, bubbling cheese, and delicious toppings, their little son watches excitedly while his parents work together. The wife helps her husband handle the pizza, and the whole family shares the happiness of preparing a special homemade meal with their own hands. ❤️

There are no fancy restaurants or modern pizza ovens—just fresh homemade ingredients, a traditional village courtyard, a handmade clay oven, and the simple happiness of a family cooking together. From preparing fresh paneer to baking a giant pizza, every step brings warmth, teamwork, and the cozy charm of Indian village life. 🌿✨

snippet.description:
※ 이 영상은 2024년 2월 20일에 방송된 ＜건축탐구집 - 운명의 집터 찾아 시골에 살 결심＞의 일부입니다.
 
유영국 씨는 2006년 첫 히말라야 트레킹을 다녀온 이후, 일명 ‘히말병’에 걸려 15년 동안 해마다 히말라야에 올랐다. 히말라야 등반은 힘들고 고통스럽지만, 그 고통이 가실 즈음 다시 생각이 난다는데. 이후에도 유영국 씨는 아내에게 지리산 귀촌을 제안하여 아내를 기겁하게 만들었다.
 
결국 부부는 합의 후 지리산이 아닌 홍성에 터를 잡았다. 땅을 계약하자 더는 지체할 이유가 없다고 생각한 유영국 씨는 곧장 텐트 하나를 들고 홍성에 내려왔다. 원시림에 가깝게 잡목이 우거진 600평 임야를 굴착기 하나 없이 손으로 베어가며 터를 닦고 3년 동안이나 텐트와 농막에서 살았다고 한다.
 
유영국 씨의 시골살이는 여기서 끝나지 않았다. 정원을 만들어야겠다는 생각에 텐트와 농막 생활을 할 때부터 마음에 드는 나무나 돌을 사기 시작했다. ‘치유의 정원’으로 만들어달라는 아내의 부탁에 모나지 않은 자갈을 고르고 마사토와 모래, 황토를 깔아 맨발 길을 만들었다고.
 
현실주의자 아내와 몽상가 남편이 서로에 대한 존중으로 지은 집을 만나본다.

snippet.title: SK하이닉스 지금 들고 있어도 될까? 외국인이 5배 판 진짜 이유
snippet.description:
4.4%. 10월 22일 방송 중 SK하이닉스 하락 폭이다. 코스피보다 더 빠졌다.
5배. 최근 한 달 외국인이 판 하이닉스 물량은 개인이 산 것의 5배가 넘는다. 기관은 별로 사지 않았다.
40%. 하이닉스 미국 ADR이 국내 본주보다 비싸게 거래되는 괴리율이다. 박시동 평론가는 TSMC가 보통 17, 18% 정도라며 기형적이라고 했다.
박시동 평론가는 하이닉스가 더 빠지는 이유를 솔리다임 미국 상장 하나로 봤다. 솔리다임 몫은 하이닉스 가치의 10% 정도. 그런데 미국에서 웃돈이 붙으면 솔리다임 쪽은 더 오르고 하이닉스는 그만큼 더 깎인다는 셈법이다. "하이닉스가 솔리다임 미국 상장을 추진하면 할수록 하이닉스는 기하급수적으로 가치가 빠지는 거예요."
오늘은 하이닉스가 미국에서 대관 로비를 시작했다는 등록 사실도 알려졌다. 미국 상장은 국내 증권신고서로 돌려보낼 수 없고, 과태료는 10억원 정도라 "껌값"이라는 말까지 나왔다.
이광수 소장은 상장을 전제로 판단하라고 했고, 박시동 평론가는 아직 받아들일 수 없다며 여론으로 막아야 한다고 했다.

· 왜 하이닉스만 (16초)
· 외국인 5배 매도 (2분 39초)
· ADR 괴리율 40% (4분 59초)
· 막을 수 없나 (7분 39초)
· 오늘의 세 줄 정리 (9분 50초)
